name: high_priest_of_leaves
description: a High Priest of Leaves (Fall from Heaven), an old druid with long white hair and a long white beard, a crown of leafy branches with small white blossoms, a thick mantle of green leaves over his shoulders, long green robes with wide sleeves and gold leaf embroidery over a cream underrobe, a brown belt with a gold buckle and a brown satchel, brown shoes, and a twisting wooden staff with leaves and white blossoms curling round a glowing green orb at its top in his RIGHT hand (screen-left); his LEFT hand (screen-right) is held out empty, palm open
hands: the leafy orb staff stays upright in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty open hand held out on the screen-right side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the leafy crown jolting, torso jolts back, the arms jerk (the staff arm yanked down to his hip on the screen-left side, still gripping the leafy green-orb staff, which tips back so its glowing orb rises beside his head; his empty open left hand flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the staff hand low at his hip on the screen-left side, the leafy green-orb staff still in it and slanting across his body toward his head, his empty open left hand still held out to the right

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the leafy green-orb staff high, his empty left hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head with its leafy crown droops, the wooden staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the green-orb end of the wooden staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the wooden staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the green robes flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the leafy crown still on his head and the white beard on his chest; the leafy green-orb staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the green robes and leaf mantle spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the leaf mantle and green robes settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the leafy wooden staff with its green orb on the ground beside him
